prompt: What is the capacity of the Olympic stadium used during the first Winter Games attended by a tropical nation? This nation was visited by the 5th Cavalry Regiment (US) in 1901.
answer: The nation was the **Philippines**, which first competed at the **1972 Sapporo Winter Olympics**. The Olympic stadium used there—the **Makomanai Open Stadium**—had a capacity of approximately **50,000 spectators**.
